text: What happens when I donate blood?

steps.title: Blood leaves
steps.say: A donation takes about a pint, roughly a tenth of your blood. This is my own general knowledge, nothing is logged in your day.

steps.title: Heart compensates
steps.say: Vessels tighten and your heart may beat a little faster to keep pressure up. You may feel light-headed if you stand fast.

closeup.basis: My own illustration of a mild rise

steps.title: Refill
steps.say: Your kidneys and gut pull water into the blood within a day. Red cells take weeks to rebuild, so go easy on hard training for a few days.

lines.text: You give about a tenth of your blood; fluid refills within a day, red cells in weeks.
